display_long_description:
I AI is a VR-only multiplayer puzzle game designed for two players. Set in a fragmented sci-fi world, the game focuses on communication, coordination, puzzle solving, and narrative-driven challenges. You and your partner must work together—often in unusual situations—to uncover a mystery rooted in time, memory, and identity. Play as one of the two androids learning to think, feel, and communicate like humans.

Rely on voice, visual cues, and shared reasoning to make progress.
Each puzzle is crafted to test how well you can interpret information, exchange ideas, and work as one.
 
# IAI - ROULETTE
Enjoy the different game modes! Take on the challenge against other players.

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zBUWUlrnlPg
[media]

# MULTIPLAYER ONLY
A cooperative experience built around two players—where communication isn’t optional, it’s essential.
[media]
  
 
# COOP PUZZLE DESIGN
Each player experiences the world differently. No single perspective is enough to solve the game’s challenges.
[media]
 
 
# CROSS PLATFORM
Play together across PC VR and Meta Quest headsets.
[media]
  
 
# NARRATIVE DRIVEN
Discover the story of the Dreamers through fragments of dialogue, environmental storytelling, and shared decisions.
[media]
  
 
# FULL BODY EXPERIANCE
See your entire body—not just your hands—in VR, deepening the sense of presence and expression.
[media]
